summary: Prepare repeated depth integration and private capture-age evidence
details: Synthetic left/center/right runner exercises accepted gate, policy, watchdog and simulated scheduler. Optional private bounded asynchronous trace preserves original capture/receipt/deadline and age interval at software command observation; excludes credentials, GPS and images and reports incomplete logging. Real phone, physical mapping and power/motor acceptance remain blocked.

Synthetic three-round run accepted each stimulus three times, wrote 18 records without drops, and ended off. Native TLS synthetic-phone test validates age logging and credential exclusion. No Pi/camera/GPIO access.
